upCreditsRunOut.question: What happens if I run out of UP Credits?
upCreditsRunOut.answer: You can purchase additional UP Credits anytime, or upgrade to a higher plan. Your work is never lost.

upCreditsRollover.question: Do unused UP Credits roll over?
upCreditsRollover.answer: No, UP Credits refresh monthly. Consider purchasing à la carte credits if you need flexibility.

changePlans.question: Can I change plans anytime?
changePlans.answer: Yes, upgrade or downgrade anytime. Prorated charges/credits applied automatically.

teamIsolatedSetup.question: What's included in the $499 setup fee for Team Isolated?
teamIsolatedSetup.answer: Server deployment, custom domain configuration, environment setup, initial agent customization, and team onboarding session.

deploymentTime.question: How long does Team Isolated deployment take?
deploymentTime.answer: Typically 3-5 business days after payment and initial consultation.

teamCreditsShared.question: Do Team plans share UP Credits?
teamCreditsShared.answer: No, each team member gets their own monthly UP Credit allocation.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes! All paid plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and wire transfers for Enterprise plans.

billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: You'll be billed monthly or annually based on your chosen plan. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

changeCancel.question: Can I change or cancel my plan?
changeCancel.answer: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. Changes take effect at the next billing cycle.

security.question: Is my payment information secure?
security.answer: Absolutely. We use Stripe for payment processing, which is PCI compliant and uses industry-standard encryption.

refunds.question: Do you offer refunds?
refunds.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. Contact support if you're not satisfied.

switchBilling.question: Can I switch between monthly and annual billing?
switchBilling.answer: Yes, you can switch between billing cycles. When switching to annual, you'll receive the discounted rate immediately.
